title: Verify gallery and ontology cross-reference integrity
abstract: Validate that published gallery-index entries resolve to existing public resources, that their ontology references use defined concepts and identifiers, and that the human-facing gallery agrees with its machine-readable index.

scope_hints.scope_boundary: Only explicitly authorized work on independent public Tarium projects

remarks: Public-source rule normalization reviewed as a distinct project-specific atom; overlapping general rules retained.
